subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `openclaw notify` admin broadcast surface now, fold shell-originated alerts into the broader Control UI notification architecture, or leave this to plugin/external delivery paths?
rationale: The requested capability is absent and plausible, but it defines a new shell-facing admin UI interruption path with authorization, payload, delivery, and UX policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Design the core notification contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the focused CLI/Gateway/Control UI feature and require an explicit admin event/RPC contract before implementation.

options.title: Fold into broader notification architecture
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20237 own the shared toast/action design and supersede this issue only after it explicitly covers shell/admin broadcast.

options.title: Prefer plugin or external delivery
options.body: Reject a core command and document the supported plugin, admin HTTP RPC, Web Push, node notify, or channel workaround if maintainers do not want shell-originated UI interruption.

recommendation.title: Design the core notification contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the focused CLI/Gateway/Control UI feature and require an explicit admin event/RPC contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest available routing candidate from current CLI/Gateway/UI blame and the product/security boundary involved.
